scope: Selected overall option 1: wider coherent desktop room framing, coordinated indoor day/night light and oatmeal/wood palette, disclosure for secondary room settings. Phone camera, furniture positions, existing objects and personal preferences retained. B3 and the original 47-item plan are unchanged. Development only, no publication or deployment changes.

method.runtime: Shared Node 24.14.0 via project-node/project-pnpm, existing dependencies and pnpm store v11; no installs or isolated environment.
method.browser: System Chrome 156.0.8078.80; actual ANGLE Metal Apple M1 Pro. Browser plugin unavailable; existing Playwright used.
method.script: Unchanged scripts/measure-performance.mjs via local measure.mjs, development server 5173. DPR1, CPU1x, reduced motion, clear simulated weather, no birds/vessels, default warm 50% room light.
method.desktop: 1280x800, ordinary quality, scene time 2026-10-31 12:00 and 22:00; three serial five-second samples for each before/after group.
method.phone: 390x844, low quality, scene time 2026-10-31 22:00; one five-second sample before and after. Desktop viewport emulation, not a physical phone.
method.isolation: GPU checks and measurements serial. Source frozen within each sample group and after the final panel correction. Temporary caffeinate with a bounded user-active assertion used for final verification; an earlier display-link/media wait and a reset entry probe passed unchanged on recheck.
method.limits: Refresh-limited short samples do not prove speedup or net GPU cost. CPU submission is not GPU completion. No Safari, physical phone, thermal, battery, long-duration or GPU memory validation.

albedo.note: Existing cotton albedo recoloured offline to oatmeal, retaining normal/roughness maps. No AI generation or runtime image preprocessing; decoded texture dimensions unchanged.

resourceChanges.description: Existing scene lights/materials adjusted; no furniture moved or added. Main, entry, cat return, album return and resize share roomComposition. Different framing can change visible draw calls through existing frustum culling. Menu is event-driven with resize/class observers, not an animation loop.
